title: GETS award notices, the current file (July 2019 on, refreshed quarterly)

header_exact: Alternative Physical Tender Box Delivery Address

signals_note: Recognised by its header line alone: eighteen columns, `Awarded Amount` before `Report Date`. Measured on the file of 15 July 2026 (a6528eaa…): 22,560 records, every one 18 fields wide, fields with line breaks inside quotes (the overview), UTF-8 throughout.

tables.key: RFx ID (GETS's own unique identifier) within the file's era
never read: Alternative Physical Tender Box Delivery Address

notes: `Awarded Date ` carries a trailing space in the header. Awarded Amount is whole dollars as digits; `0` stands where no value is given (13,159 of 17,767 awarded notices on 15 July 2026), so a 0 is kept as published and is not a value. 'Not Awarded' is also how an agency marks a tender it awarded off the system (the schema workbook). CC BY 3.0 NZ (the catalogue's package description); attribution to the Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment

config.encoding: utf-8, then Windows-1252 per field, then Latin-1 per field (a counted note)

process: Decode each field as UTF-8, else as Windows-1252, else Latin-1, counting each fallback.
Read every record; a record whose RFx ID is empty or repeats within the file is set aside.
Dates read day first by keys.dates.filed_date; one that is not a real day is left empty and counted.
gates: The file's record count equals the old estate's for the pinned file of 14 August 2026 (22,560).
on_fail: the whole file set aside, nothing read from it

by: tenders-1 session (Opus), step 6.2 template 1 (to be appended by the integrator at tenders-1)
title: GETS supplier data: the suppliers named on each notice (both eras)
signals_note: Recognised by its header line alone. The same layout in both eras; the era is the file's name. Measured: 24,113 records (current, 412cd7cd…, 56 fields in Windows-1252) and 7,152 (historic, 5d286f9a…).

tables.one record: one supplier named on one notice
tables.key: the era, the RFx ID and the supplier as published (name and business-number field), with an ordinal for an exact repeat

notes: `Supplier NZBN` is 'not validated' (the schema workbook) and holds, as published: a number in spreadsheet exponent form that has lost its digits (`9.42904E+12`: 11,476 current records and 1,168 historic), empty or `NULL`, company numbers, GST numbers and free text. On 14 August 2026 no record held a 13-digit NZBN. The field is kept as published; `nzbn` is filled only where it is a valid 13-digit number; `nzbn_form` names the shape. Full Address and Website are never read (hard limit 15): a supplier may be a sole trader. CC BY 3.0 NZ (the catalogue's package description); attribution to the Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment

config.encoding: utf-8, then Windows-1252 per field, then Latin-1 per field

process: Every record becomes a supplier row of the notice its RFx ID names in the same era, or a catch-log line.
gates: Records in = supplier rows + catch-log lines.
Every supplier row names a notice of its era.
on_fail: the whole file set aside, nothing read from it
